execute.sql: CREATE SCHEMA IF NOT EXISTS "public"

CREATE TABLE "public"."app_users" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "email" text NOT NULL,
  "full_name" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "password_hash" text NOT NULL,
  "phone" text,
  "preferred_language" text,
  "role" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."caregiver_patients" (
  "caregiver_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_primary" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "relationship" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cognitive_performance" (
  "accuracy_percent" numeric,
  "average_response_ms" int4,
  "cognitive_domain" text NOT NULL,
  "difficulty_level" int4,
  "error_rate" numeric,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "measured_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "score" numeric,
  "session_id" uuid,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."cultural_content" (
  "category" text NOT NULL,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(6),
  "description" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "language_code" text,
  "metadata" json DEFAULT '"{}"'::json,
  "region" text,
  "title" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."daily_care_logs" (
  "caregiver_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "hydration_ml" int4,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "meals_completed" int4,
  "mood" text,
  "notes" text,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "sleepHours" numeric,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."devices" (
  "appVersion" text,
  "caregiver_id" uuid,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "device_id" text NOT NULL,
  "device_name" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "last_sync_at" timestamptz(6),
  "patient_id" uuid,
  "platform" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."game_items" (
  "correct_answer" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cultural_content_id" uuid,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(6),
  "difficulty" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "game_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "mediaIds" json DEFAULT '"[]"'::json,
  "metadata" json DEFAULT '"{}"'::json,
  "options" json DEFAULT '"[]"'::json,
  "question_text" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."game_responses" (
  "answer_given" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "difficulty_at_attempt" int4,
  "game_item_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "hesitation_ms" int4,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_correct" bool,
  "question_number" int4,
  "response_time_ms" int4,
  "session_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."game_sessions" (
  "average_response_ms" int4,
  "client_created_at" timestamptz(6),
  "completedAt" timestamptz(6),
  "correct_answers" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "device_id" text,
  "final_difficulty" int4,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "initial_difficulty" int4,
  "moodAfter" text,
  "moodBefore" text,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "started_at" timestamptz(6) NOT NULL,
  "sync_status" text DEFAULT 'pending',
  "total_questions" int4 DEFAULT 0,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."games" (
  "cognitive_domain" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "difficulty_max" int4 DEFAULT 5 NOT NULL,
  "difficulty_min" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "game_type" text NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "language_code" text,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."languages" (
  "code" text NOT NULL,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "name" text NOT NULL,
  "native_name" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("code")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."media_assets" (
  "checksum" text,
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "cultural_content_id" uuid,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(6),
  "duration_seconds" numeric,
  "file_name" text NOT NULL,
  "file_size_bytes" int8,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "local_file_key" text,
  "media_type" text NOT NULL,
  "storage_url" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."medication_logs" (
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "medication_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "status" text DEFAULT 'pending' NOT NULL,
  "taken_at" timestamptz(6),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."medications" (
  "dosage" text,
  "end_date" date,
  "frequency" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "instructions" text,
  "is_active" bool DEFAULT true NOT NULL,
  "medicine_name" text NOT NULL,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "scheduled_time" time,
  "start_date" date,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."patients" (
  "consent_status" text DEFAULT 'pending',
  "created_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "date_of_birth" date,
  "deleted_at" timestamptz(6),
  "dementia_stage" text,
  "display_name" text NOT NULL,
  "district" text,
  "emergency_contact_name" text,
  "emergency_contact_phone" text,
  "gender" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "patient_code" text NOT NULL,
  "primary_language" text,
  "state" text,
  "updated_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "user_id" uuid,
  "village" text,
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."safety_checkins" (
  "accuracy_meters" numeric,
  "checkin_type" text,
  "device_id" text,
  "id" uuid DEFAULT (gen_random_uuid()) NOT NULL,
  "latitude" numeric,
  "longitude" numeric,
  "patient_id" uuid NOT NULL,
  "recorded_at" timestamptz(6) DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  "synced_at" timestamptz(6),
  PRIMARY KEY ("id")
)
